title: Urgent Session: Land, Lawsuits & Leader Search
summary:
*   An emergency meeting was called to enter into an executive session, discussing sensitive topics behind closed doors.
*   The confidential discussions covered matters related to land acquisition, ongoing litigation, and various personnel issues.
*   A key focus of the executive session involved the search process for a new City Manager.
*   No final public decisions or votes were taken on any of these subjects during this emergency session.
